rows.name:
I received a letter from Harhal,
with some money attached.

rows.label: tlk4560015501_msg0002
rows.name:
The letter only said, 'I'm doing fine,
so don't worry'...

rows.label: tlk4560015501_msg0003
rows.name:
I don't know where or what's going on,
but knowing that all is well is enough
for me.
